name: Rotator Cuff Tear Arthropathy
definition: Advanced shoulder dysfunction caused by chronic massive rotator cuff deficiency with superior humeral migration and secondary glenohumeral degenerative change.

investigations.principle: Radiographs show superior migration and arthropathy; ultrasound/MRI evaluates cuff if needed.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Reverse shoulder arthroplasty is considered for selected severe cases with preserved deltoid function.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Amsa Sandhigata-Vata-like phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Advanced shoulder dysfunction caused by chronic massive rotator cuff deficiency with superior humeral migration and secondary glenohumeral degenerative change.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
